# f5xc_proxy (Data Source)

Proxy view defines a required parameters that can be used in CRUD, to create and manage a Proxy.<br><br>View will create following child objects.<br><br>* virtual_host<br>* advertise_policy<br>* service_policy_set

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Proxy - Full

data "f5xc_proxy" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_proxy.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_proxy.example.namespace
}
```

- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''

Read-Only:

- `dns_choice` (Attributes) DNS Masquerade If DNS masquerade is enabled, Site will respond to DNS queries of configured domains with proxy's VIP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--dns_choice))
- `domains` (List of String) Domains A list of Domains to be proxied. Wildcard hosts are supported in the suffix or prefix form Supported Domains and search order: 1. Exact Domain names: www.foo.com. 2. Domains starting with a Wildcard: *.foo.com. Not supported Domains: - Just a Wildcard: * - A Wildcard and TLD with no root Domain: *.com. - A Wildcard not matching a whole DNS label. e.g. *.foo.com and *.bar.foo.com are valid Wildcards however *bar.foo.com, *-bar.foo.com, and bar*.foo.com are all invalid. Additional notes: A Wildcard will not match empty string. e.g. *.foo.com will match bar.foo.com and baz-bar.foo.com but not .foo.com. The longest Wildcards match first. Only a single virtual host in the entire route configuration can match on *. Also a Domain must be unique across all virtual hosts within an advertise policy.

### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option.buffer_policy`

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Boolean) disable Disable buffering for a particular route. This is useful when virtual-host has buffering, but we need to disable it on a specific route. The value of this field is ignored for virtual-host
- `max_request_bytes` (Number) max_request_bytes The maximum request size that the filter will buffer before the connection manager will stop buffering and return a RequestEntityTooLarge (413) response.


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--compression_params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option.compression_params`

Read-Only:

- `content_length` (Number) content_length Minimum response length, in bytes, which will trigger compression. The default value is 30.
- `content_type` (List of String) content_type Set of strings that allows specifying which mime-types yield compression When this field is not defined, compression will be applied to the following mime-types: 'application/javascript' 'application/json', 'application/xhtml+xml' 'image/svg+xml' 'text/css' 'text/html' 'text/plain' 'text/xml'
- `disable_on_etag_header` (Boolean) disable_on_etag_header If true, disables compression when the response contains an etag header. When it is false, weak etags will be preserved and the ones that require strong validation will be removed.
- `remove_accept_encoding_header` (Boolean) remove_accept_encoding_header If true, removes accept-encoding from the request headers before dispatching it to the upstream so that responses do not get compressed before reaching the filter.

- `location` (String) Location Location is the uri_ref. It could be in url format for string:/// Or it could be a path if the store provider is an http/https location
- `store_provider` (String) Store Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///

- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL URL of the secret. Currently supported URL schemes is string:///. For string:/// scheme, Secret needs to be encoded Base64 format. When asked for this secret, caller will get Secret bytes after Base64 decoding.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy`

Read-Only:

- `more_option` (Attributes) AdvancedMore Options Advanced More options like header manipulation, compression etc. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option))
- `tls_params` (Attributes) Down Stream TLS Parameters Fake down stream TLS Parameters like certificate, private key, etc for all destinations of proxy (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params))

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.more_option`

Read-Only:

- `buffer_policy` (Attributes) Buffer configuration for requests Some upstream applications are not capable of handling streamed data and high network latency. This config enables buffering the entire request before sending to upstream application. We can specify the maximum buffer size and buffer interval with this config. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--buffer_policy))
- `compression_params` (Attributes) Compression configuration Enables load balancer to compress dispatched data from an upstream service upon client request. Only GZIP compression is supported (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--compression_params))
- `custom_errors` (Map of String) Custom Errors Map of integer error codes as keys and string values that can be used to provide custom http pages for each error code. Key of the map can be either response code class or HTTP Error code. Response code classes for key is configured as follows 3 -- for 3xx response code class 4 -- for 4xx response code class 5 -- for 5xx response code class Value of the map is string which represents custom HTTP responses. Specific response code takes preference when both response code and response code class matches for a request.
- `disable_default_error_pages` (Boolean) Disable the use of default F5XC error pages Disable the use of default F5XC error pages.
- `http10_choice` (Attributes) Allow HTTP/1.0 Control whether HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/0.9 requests are accepted or rejected on this load balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--http10_choice))
- `idle_timeout` (Number) Idle timeout The amount of time that a stream can exist without upstream or downstream activity, in milliseconds. The stream is terminated with a HTTP 504 (Gateway Timeout) error code if no upstream response header has been received, otherwise the stream is reset.
- `max_request_header_size` (Number) Maximum request header size The maximum request header size for downstream connections, in KiB. A HTTP 431 (Request Header Fields Too Large) error code is sent for requests that exceed this size. If multiple load balancers share the same advertise_policy, the highest value configured across all such load balancers is used for all the load balancers in question.
- `max_requests_per_connection_choice` (Attributes) max_requests_per_connection Sets the maximum number of requests a downstream client can send over a single connection to Envoy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--max_requests_per_connection_choice))
- `request_cookies_to_add` (Attributes List) Cookies to add in request Cookies are key-value pairs to be added to HTTP request being routed towards upstream. Cookies specified at this level are applied after cookies from matched Route are applied (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add))
- `request_cookies_to_remove` (List of String) Cookies to be removed from request List of keys of Cookies to be removed from the HTTP request being sent towards upstream.
- `request_headers_to_add` (Attributes List) Headers to add in request Headers are key-value pairs to be added to HTTP request being routed towards upstream. Headers specified at this level are applied after headers from matched Route are applied (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--request_headers_to_add))
- `request_headers_to_remove` (List of String) Header to be removed from request List of keys of Headers to be removed from the HTTP request being sent towards upstream.
- `response_cookies_to_add` (Attributes List) Cookies to add in set-cookie header in response Cookies are name-value pairs along with optional attribute parameters to be added to HTTP response being sent towards downstream. Cookies specified at this level are applied after cookies from matched Route are applied (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add))
- `response_cookies_to_remove` (List of String) Cookies to be removed from response List of name of Cookies to be removed from the HTTP response being sent towards downstream. Entire set-cookie header will be removed
- `response_headers_to_add` (Attributes List) Headers to add in response Headers are key-value pairs to be added to HTTP response being sent towards downstream. Headers specified at this level are applied after headers from matched Route are applied (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_headers_to_add))
- `response_headers_to_remove` (List of String) Header to be removed from response List of keys of Headers to be removed from the HTTP response being sent towards downstream.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--buffer_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.more_option.buffer_policy`

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Boolean) disable Disable buffering for a particular route. This is useful when virtual-host has buffering, but we need to disable it on a specific route. The value of this field is ignored for virtual-host
- `max_request_bytes` (Number) max_request_bytes The maximum request size that the filter will buffer before the connection manager will stop buffering and return a RequestEntityTooLarge (413) response.


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--compression_params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.more_option.compression_params`

Read-Only:

- `content_length` (Number) content_length Minimum response length, in bytes, which will trigger compression. The default value is 30.
- `content_type` (List of String) content_type Set of strings that allows specifying which mime-types yield compression When this field is not defined, compression will be applied to the following mime-types: 'application/javascript' 'application/json', 'application/xhtml+xml' 'image/svg+xml' 'text/css' 'text/html' 'text/plain' 'text/xml'
- `disable_on_etag_header` (Boolean) disable_on_etag_header If true, disables compression when the response contains an etag header. When it is false, weak etags will be preserved and the ones that require strong validation will be removed.
- `remove_accept_encoding_header` (Boolean) remove_accept_encoding_header If true, removes accept-encoding from the request headers before dispatching it to the upstream so that responses do not get compressed before reaching the filter.


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--http10_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.more_option.http10_choice`

Read-Only:

- `disable_http10` (Boolean) Disable HTTP/1.0 Reject HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/0.9 traffic on this LB.
- `enable_http10` (Boolean) Enable HTTP/1.0 Allow HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/0.9 traffic on this LB.


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--max_requests_per_connection_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.more_option.max_requests_per_connection_choice`

Read-Only:

- `max_requests_per_connection` (Number) Maximum Requests Per Connection Sets the maximum number of requests a downstream client can send over a single connection to Envoy. Enter a value >=1 to define the request limit per connection.
- `no_request_limit_per_connection` (Boolean) Disable the max requests per connection option This option disables the maximum requests per connection limit. When selected, no limit is enforced, and connections can handle unlimited requests.

- `expiry_choice` (Attributes) Expiry Indicates the maximum lifetime of the cookie as an HTTP-date timestamp. Eg. Mon, 01 Dec 2008 00:23:53 GMT (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add--expiry_choice))
- `httponly_choice` (Attributes) httponly A cookie with the HttpOnly attribute is inaccessible to the JavaScript. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add--httponly_choice))
- `max_age_choice` (Attributes) max_age Enter the maximum age in minutes for session cookies after which cookies are automatically expired (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add--max_age_choice))
- `name` (String) name Name of the cookie in Cookie header.
- `overwrite` (Boolean) overwrite Should the value be overwritten? If true, the value is overwritten to existing values. Default value is do not overwrite
- `partitioned_choice` (Attributes) Partitioned A cookie with the Partitioned attribute is stored using partitioned storage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add--partitioned_choice))
- `path_choice` (Attributes) path The path that must exist in the requested URL for the browser to send the Cookie header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add--path_choice))
- `samesite_choice` (Attributes) samesite Controls whether or not a cookie is sent with cross-site requests (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add--samesite_choice))
- `secure_choice` (Attributes) secure A cookie with the Secure attribute is only sent to the server with an encrypted request over the HTTPS protocol and therefore, is more resistant to man-in-the-middle attacks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add--secure_choice))
- `value_choice` (Attributes) value Enter Cookie value as string or blindfolded secret. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add--value_choice))

- `use_mtls` (Attributes) Use mTLS (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--mtls_choice--use_mtls))

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--mtls_choice--use_mtls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.tls_params.mtls_choice.use_mtls`

Read-Only:

- `client_certificate_optional` (Boolean) client_certificate_optional Client certificate is optional. If the client has provided a certificate, the load balancer will verify it. If certification verification fails, the connection will be terminated. If the client does not provide a certificate, the connection will be accepted.
- `crl_choice` (Attributes) crl choice Whether to verify client certificate revocation status with certificate revocation list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--mtls_choice--use_mtls--crl_choice))
- `trusted_ca_choice` (Attributes) trusted_ca_choice Root CA configuration for downstream TLS connections (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--mtls_choice--use_mtls--trusted_ca_choice))

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--mtls_choice--use_mtls--crl_choice"></a>

Specify the CRL server information to download the certificate revocation list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--mtls_choice--use_mtls--crl_choice--crl))
- `no_crl` (Boolean) No client certificate verification with CRL Client certificate revocation status is not verified

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.tls_params.tls_certificates`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_url` (String) certificate_url TLS certificate. Certificate or certificate chain in PEM format including the PEM headers.
- `description` (String) description Description for the certificate
- `ocsp_stapling_choice` (Attributes) OCSP Response choice OCSP Stapling choice (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_certificates--ocsp_stapling_choice))
- `private_key` (Attributes) private_key TLS Private Key data in unencrypted PEM format including the PEM headers. The data may be optionally secured using BlindFold. TLS key has to match the accompanying certificate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_certificates--private_key))

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_certificates--ocsp_stapling_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.tls_params.tls_certificates.ocsp_stapling_choice`

Read-Only:

- `custom_hash_algorithms` (Attributes) Use Custom Order for Hash Algorithms Use hash algorithms in the custom order. F5XC will try to fetch ocsp response from the CA in the given order. Additionally, LoadBalancer will not become active until ocspResponse cannot be fetched if the certificate has MustStaple extension set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_certificates--ocsp_stapling_choice--custom_hash_algorithms))
- `disable_ocsp_stapling` (Boolean) Disable OCSP Stapling Disable OCSP Stapling. F5XC will not fetch and staple OCSP Response for this certificate. This is the default behavior if no choice is selected.
- `use_system_defaults` (Boolean) Fetch with F5XC default settings Use F5XC Default Settings to fetch and staple OCSP Response. OCSP Response will be stapled if it can be fetched. Additionally, LoadBalancer will not become active until ocspResponse cannot be fetched if the certificate has MustStaple extension set. F5XC will try to fetch OCSPResponse with sha256 and sha1 as HashAlgorithm, in that order.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_certificates--ocsp_stapling_choice--custom_hash_algorithms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.tls_params.tls_certificates.ocsp_stapling_choice.custom_hash_algorithms`

Read-Only:

- `choice` (Attributes) TLS Security Level The security level for TLS handshake between client/server and the platform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_config--choice))

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_config--choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.tls_params.tls_config.choice`

Read-Only:

- `custom_security` (Attributes) Custom Security Custom selection of TLS versions and cipher suites (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_config--choice--custom_security))
- `default_security` (Boolean) Default Security TLS v1.2+ with PFS ciphers and strong crypto algorithms.
- `low_security` (Boolean) Low Security TLS v1.0+ including non-PFS ciphers and weak crypto algorithms.
- `medium_security` (Boolean) Medium Security TLS v1.0+ with PFS ciphers and medium strength crypto algorithms.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--https_proxy--tls_params--tls_config--choice--custom_security"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.https_proxy.tls_params.tls_config.choice.custom_security`

Read-Only:

- `cipher_suites` (List of String) cipher_suites The TLS listener will only support the specified cipher list.
- `max_version` (List of String) maximum_protocol_version Maximum TLS protocol version.
- `min_version` (List of String) minimum_protocol_version Minimum TLS protocol version.






<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--dynamic_proxy--proxy_choice--sni_proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.dynamic_proxy.proxy_choice.sni_proxy`

Read-Only:

- `idle_timeout` (Number) Idle timeout The amount of time that a stream can exist without upstream or downstream activity, in milliseconds.




<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy`

Read-Only:

- `http_https_choice` (Attributes) HTTP Connect HTTP connect proxy (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--http_https_choice))
- `more_option` (Attributes) AdvancedMore Options Advanced More options like header manipulation, compression etc. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option))

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--http_https_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy.http_https_choice`

Read-Only:

- `enable_http` (Boolean) HTTP Connect HTTP connect transaction is in cleartext(unencrypted)


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option`

Read-Only:

- `buffer_policy` (Attributes) Buffer configuration for requests Some upstream applications are not capable of handling streamed data and high network latency. This config enables buffering the entire request before sending to upstream application. We can specify the maximum buffer size and buffer interval with this config. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--buffer_policy))
- `compression_params` (Attributes) Compression configuration Enables load balancer to compress dispatched data from an upstream service upon client request. Only GZIP compression is supported (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--compression_params))
- `custom_errors` (Map of String) Custom Errors Map of integer error codes as keys and string values that can be used to provide custom http pages for each error code. Key of the map can be either response code class or HTTP Error code. Response code classes for key is configured as follows 3 -- for 3xx response code class 4 -- for 4xx response code class 5 -- for 5xx response code class Value of the map is string which represents custom HTTP responses. Specific response code takes preference when both response code and response code class matches for a request.
- `disable_default_error_pages` (Boolean) Disable the use of default F5XC error pages Disable the use of default F5XC error pages.
- `http10_choice` (Attributes) Allow HTTP/1.0 Control whether HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/0.9 requests are accepted or rejected on this load balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--http10_choice))
- `idle_timeout` (Number) Idle timeout The amount of time that a stream can exist without upstream or downstream activity, in milliseconds. The stream is terminated with a HTTP 504 (Gateway Timeout) error code if no upstream response header has been received, otherwise the stream is reset.
- `max_request_header_size` (Number) Maximum request header size The maximum request header size for downstream connections, in KiB. A HTTP 431 (Request Header Fields Too Large) error code is sent for requests that exceed this size. If multiple load balancers share the same advertise_policy, the highest value configured across all such load balancers is used for all the load balancers in question.
- `max_requests_per_connection_choice` (Attributes) max_requests_per_connection Sets the maximum number of requests a downstream client can send over a single connection to Envoy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--max_requests_per_connection_choice))
- `request_cookies_to_add` (Attributes List) Cookies to add in request Cookies are key-value pairs to be added to HTTP request being routed towards upstream. Cookies specified at this level are applied after cookies from matched Route are applied (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add))
- `request_cookies_to_remove` (List of String) Cookies to be removed from request List of keys of Cookies to be removed from the HTTP request being sent towards upstream.
- `request_headers_to_add` (Attributes List) Headers to add in request Headers are key-value pairs to be added to HTTP request being routed towards upstream. Headers specified at this level are applied after headers from matched Route are applied (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_headers_to_add))
- `request_headers_to_remove` (List of String) Header to be removed from request List of keys of Headers to be removed from the HTTP request being sent towards upstream.
- `response_cookies_to_add` (Attributes List) Cookies to add in set-cookie header in response Cookies are name-value pairs along with optional attribute parameters to be added to HTTP response being sent towards downstream. Cookies specified at this level are applied after cookies from matched Route are applied (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add))
- `response_cookies_to_remove` (List of String) Cookies to be removed from response List of name of Cookies to be removed from the HTTP response being sent towards downstream. Entire set-cookie header will be removed
- `response_headers_to_add` (Attributes List) Headers to add in response Headers are key-value pairs to be added to HTTP response being sent towards downstream. Headers specified at this level are applied after headers from matched Route are applied (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_headers_to_add))
- `response_headers_to_remove` (List of String) Header to be removed from response List of keys of Headers to be removed from the HTTP response being sent towards downstream.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--buffer_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option.buffer_policy`

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Boolean) disable Disable buffering for a particular route. This is useful when virtual-host has buffering, but we need to disable it on a specific route. The value of this field is ignored for virtual-host
- `max_request_bytes` (Number) max_request_bytes The maximum request size that the filter will buffer before the connection manager will stop buffering and return a RequestEntityTooLarge (413) response.


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--compression_params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option.compression_params`

Read-Only:

- `content_length` (Number) content_length Minimum response length, in bytes, which will trigger compression. The default value is 30.
- `content_type` (List of String) content_type Set of strings that allows specifying which mime-types yield compression When this field is not defined, compression will be applied to the following mime-types: 'application/javascript' 'application/json', 'application/xhtml+xml' 'image/svg+xml' 'text/css' 'text/html' 'text/plain' 'text/xml'
- `disable_on_etag_header` (Boolean) disable_on_etag_header If true, disables compression when the response contains an etag header. When it is false, weak etags will be preserved and the ones that require strong validation will be removed.
- `remove_accept_encoding_header` (Boolean) remove_accept_encoding_header If true, removes accept-encoding from the request headers before dispatching it to the upstream so that responses do not get compressed before reaching the filter.


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--http10_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option.http10_choice`

Read-Only:

- `disable_http10` (Boolean) Disable HTTP/1.0 Reject HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/0.9 traffic on this LB.
- `enable_http10` (Boolean) Enable HTTP/1.0 Allow HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/0.9 traffic on this LB.


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--max_requests_per_connection_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option.max_requests_per_connection_choice`

Read-Only:

- `max_requests_per_connection` (Number) Maximum Requests Per Connection Sets the maximum number of requests a downstream client can send over a single connection to Envoy. Enter a value >=1 to define the request limit per connection.
- `no_request_limit_per_connection` (Boolean) Disable the max requests per connection option This option disables the maximum requests per connection limit. When selected, no limit is enforced, and connections can handle unlimited requests.


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option.request_cookies_to_add`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) name Name of the cookie in Cookie header.
- `overwrite` (Boolean) overwrite Should the value be overwritten? If true, the value is overwritten to existing values. Default value is do not overwrite
- `value_choice` (Attributes) value Enter Cookie value as string or blindfolded secret. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add--value_choice))

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add--value_choice"></a>

- `value` (String) value Value of the Cookie header.

### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option.request_cookies_to_add.value_choice.secret_value`

Read-Only:

- `secret_info_choice` (Attributes) SecretInfoOneof Secret can be one of the following types - * Blindfold Secret - Secret is managed by F5XC Secret Management System * Clear Secret - Secret is not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice))

Read-Only:

- `blindfold_secret_info` (Attributes) Blindfold Secret Blindfold Secret is used for the secrets managed by F5XC Secret Management Service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info))
- `clear_secret_info` (Attributes) Clear Secret Clear Secret is used for the secrets that are not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info))
- `none` (Boolean) None No private key will be stored or used. Choose this only when you need a public certificate for verification (e.g., validating SAML/JWT signatures). Not suitable for TLS or any use case that requires presenting a certificate, those will fail without a private key.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info"></a>

- `location` (String) Location Location is the uri_ref. It could be in url format for string:/// Or it could be a path if the store provider is an http/https location
- `store_provider` (String) Store Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--request_cookies_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info"></a>

- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL URL of the secret. Currently supported URL schemes is string:///. For string:/// scheme, Secret needs to be encoded Base64 format. When asked for this secret, caller will get Secret bytes after Base64 decoding.

- `max_age_choice` (Attributes) max_age Enter the maximum age in minutes for session cookies after which cookies are automatically expired (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_cookies_to_add--max_age_choice))

- `name` (String) name Name of the HTTP header.
- `value_choice` (Attributes) value Enter Header value as string or blindfolded secret. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_headers_to_add--value_choice))

- `value` (String) value Value of the HTTP header.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_headers_to_add--value_choice--secret_value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy_choice.http_proxy.more_option.response_headers_to_add.value_choice.secret_value`

Read-Only:

- `secret_info_choice` (Attributes) SecretInfoOneof Secret can be one of the following types - * Blindfold Secret - Secret is managed by F5XC Secret Management System * Clear Secret - Secret is not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_headers_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice))

Read-Only:

- `blindfold_secret_info` (Attributes) Blindfold Secret Blindfold Secret is used for the secrets managed by F5XC Secret Management Service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_headers_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info))
- `clear_secret_info` (Attributes) Clear Secret Clear Secret is used for the secrets that are not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_headers_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info))
- `none` (Boolean) None No private key will be stored or used. Choose this only when you need a public certificate for verification (e.g., validating SAML/JWT signatures). Not suitable for TLS or any use case that requires presenting a certificate, those will fail without a private key.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_headers_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info"></a>

Read-Only:

- `decryption_provider` (String) Decryption Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the backend Secret Management service.
- `location` (String) Location Location is the uri_ref. It could be in url format for string:/// Or it could be a path if the store provider is an http/https location
- `store_provider` (String) Store Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///


<a id="nestedatt--proxy_choice--http_proxy--more_option--response_headers_to_add--value_choice--secret_value--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info"></a>

Read-Only:

- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL URL of the secret. Currently supported URL schemes is string:///. For string:/// scheme, Secret needs to be encoded Base64 format. When asked for this secret, caller will get Secret bytes after Base64 decoding.

<a id="nestedatt--tls_interception_choice--tls_intercept--signing_cert_choice--custom_certificate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tls_interception_choice.tls_intercept.signing_cert_choice.custom_certificate`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_url` (String) certificate_url TLS certificate. Certificate or certificate chain in PEM format including the PEM headers.
- `description` (String) description Description for the certificate
- `ocsp_stapling_choice` (Attributes) OCSP Response choice OCSP Stapling choice (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tls_interception_choice--tls_intercept--signing_cert_choice--custom_certificate--ocsp_stapling_choice))
- `private_key` (Attributes) private_key TLS Private Key data in unencrypted PEM format including the PEM headers. The data may be optionally secured using BlindFold. TLS key has to match the accompanying certificate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tls_interception_choice--tls_intercept--signing_cert_choice--custom_certificate--private_key))

<a id="nestedatt--tls_interception_choice--tls_intercept--signing_cert_choice--custom_certificate--ocsp_stapling_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tls_interception_choice.tls_intercept.signing_cert_choice.custom_certificate.ocsp_stapling_choice`

Read-Only:

- `custom_hash_algorithms` (Attributes) Use Custom Order for Hash Algorithms Use hash algorithms in the custom order. F5XC will try to fetch ocsp response from the CA in the given order. Additionally, LoadBalancer will not become active until ocspResponse cannot be fetched if the certificate has MustStaple extension set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tls_interception_choice--tls_intercept--signing_cert_choice--custom_certificate--ocsp_stapling_choice--custom_hash_algorithms))
- `disable_ocsp_stapling` (Boolean) Disable OCSP Stapling Disable OCSP Stapling. F5XC will not fetch and staple OCSP Response for this certificate. This is the default behavior if no choice is selected.
- `use_system_defaults` (Boolean) Fetch with F5XC default settings Use F5XC Default Settings to fetch and staple OCSP Response. OCSP Response will be stapled if it can be fetched. Additionally, LoadBalancer will not become active until ocspResponse cannot be fetched if the certificate has MustStaple extension set. F5XC will try to fetch OCSPResponse with sha256 and sha1 as HashAlgorithm, in that order.

<a id="nestedatt--tls_interception_choice--tls_intercept--signing_cert_choice--custom_certificate--ocsp_stapling_choice--custom_hash_algorithms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tls_interception_choice.tls_intercept.signing_cert_choice.custom_certificate.ocsp_stapling_choice.custom_hash_algorithms`

Read-Only:

- `hash_algorithms` (List of String) Hash Algorithms Ordered list of hash algorithms to be used.
